title: SMC live-overlay payload (smc-live-overlay/1)
description: Flat live-overlay payload served at GET /smc_live for authenticated API clients. Every data field is optional and nullable: an absent or null field means the service has no fresh value for that field. This schema is not a Pine transport; Pine has no arbitrary HTTP client.

schema.description: Contract identifier; consumers reject payloads whose schema they do not understand.

symbol.description: Ticker the overlay describes, e.g. NVDA.

tf.description: Chart timeframe the overlay was computed for. Indicators are aggregated from 1-minute bars to this timeframe.

asof_ts.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the overlay was produced. Consumers compare it with their freshness budget.

stale.description: Server-side freshness verdict. True means the producer already knows the payload is older than its target refresh budget; consumers must not treat its optional values as current.

news_strength.description: B1. Magnitude of the mean signed news score in [0,1] — |mean|, so opposing stories cancel (NOT a coverage/intensity count) (live snapshot, ~10min TTL). Null when no fresh reading is available.

news_bias.description: B1. Directional news bias from the live snapshot. Null when undetermined.

flow_rel_vol.description: B1. Relative volume vs baseline (>=0). Null when no fresh value is available.

squeeze_on.description: B1. Volatility-squeeze flag from a price-volatility read (Bollinger-band width < Keltner-channel width; no volume input) (1=on, 0=off). Null when not served fresh.

vix_level.description: B2. Spot VIX level (>=0) from the dedicated market-wide ^VIX quote path. Absent or null when no fresh value is available.

flow_delta_proxy_pct.description: DEPRECATED compatibility field. This is candle-body return (close-open)/open*100, not order-flow delta. New consumers use price_candle_body_return_pct.

ats_state.description: DEPRECATED compatibility field. Accumulation/distribution state from price direction and volume z-score; it is not average trade size. New consumers use volume_accumulation_distribution_state.

ats_zscore.description: DEPRECATED compatibility field. Z-score of the current bar's volume vs the rolling bar window; it is not average trade size. New consumers use volume_current_bar_zscore.

price_candle_body_return_pct.description: Canonical candle-body return in percent: (close-open)/open*100. This is not order-flow delta.

volume_accumulation_distribution_state.description: Canonical accumulation/distribution state derived from price direction and current-bar volume z-score. It is not average trade size.

volume_current_bar_zscore.description: Canonical current-bar volume z-score against the rolling bar window. It is not average trade size.

tone.description: B2. Aggregate market-tone label from the live snapshot. Absent or null when no fresh value is available.

global_heat.description: B2/C. Aggregate directional heat in [-1,1]: the clamped mean of per-story signed news scores (sentiment_score, else news_score) from the live snapshot; news-only (no technical term). Absent or null when no fresh value is available.

event_window_state.description: Event-risk. Macro/earnings event-window state for the symbol (CLEAR/PRE_EVENT/ACTIVE/COOLDOWN) from the event calendar. Absent or null when no fresh value is available.

event_risk_level.description: Event-risk. Aggregate event-risk level for the symbol (NONE/LOW/ELEVATED/HIGH). Absent (or null) when not served fresh.

next_event_name.description: Event-risk. Human-readable name of the next known risk event for the symbol (e.g. an earnings announcement). Absent (or null) when none is known or not served fresh.

next_event_time.description: Event-risk. Time-of-day label of the next known risk event for the symbol (e.g. "14:00", exchange-local). Absent (or null) when none is known or not served fresh.

market_event_blocked.description: Event-risk. True when a market-wide event window blocks new entries. Absent (or null) when not served fresh; the overlay may only assert a block, never lift the baked posture.

symbol_event_blocked.description: Event-risk. True when a symbol-specific event window (e.g. earnings inside the guard window) blocks new entries. Absent (or null) when not served fresh; the overlay may only assert a block, never lift the baked posture.

event_provider_status.description: Event-risk producer health. The current placeholder producer returns 'unknown'; neutral event states are never emitted without a real calendar source.

signal_level.description: RT. Active realtime breakout signal level for the symbol (A0=confirmed, A1=forming, A2=early warning). Null when no active signal.

signal_direction.description: RT. Direction of the active realtime signal (e.g. LONG/SHORT/B_UP/B_DOWN). Null when no active signal.

trade_entry.description: RT. Trade-context entry reference (signal price) from open_prep/trade_context.py — display guidance (same numbers as the Slack push), NOT order placement. Null when no active signal or no usable ATR.

trade_stop.description: RT. Trade-context ATR-based stop level from open_prep/trade_context.py — display guidance (same numbers as the Slack push), NOT order placement. Null when no active signal or no usable ATR.

trade_target.description: RT. Trade-context ATR-based target level from open_prep/trade_context.py — display guidance (same numbers as the Slack push), NOT order placement. Null when no active signal or no usable ATR.

trade_r.description: RT. Trade-context reward:risk multiple of the bracket from open_prep/trade_context.py — display guidance (same numbers as the Slack push), NOT order placement. Null when no active signal or no usable ATR.
